boundary: Actual Rust engine-v5 WASM, pinned JS awareness/relative-position oracle, real journal/outbox adapters with prepared IndexedDB transactions and copied socket frames; no credentials/network

cases.name: Rust portable anchors roundtrip through JS relative-position oracle and awareness in both directions
relative selections move under remote inserts and fail safely after semantic target deletion
stale peers expire exactly at deadline; duplicate/reordered clocks cannot resurrect or extend lifetime
burst coalescing, backpressure and thrown sends retain one bounded pending state
host-driven renewal and clear presence use compatible clocks without idle traffic
invalid, surrogate-interior, wrong-lineage and wrong-source cursors fail atomically
malformed UTF-8/JSON, oversized, truncated, noncanonical and duplicate frames do not change peers
capacity includes expired tombstones; untrusted remote frames cannot remove local presence
replacement, expiry, invalid batch and disposal release every imported anchor
reentrant send cannot erase a newer queued state or undo disposal
awareness traffic never changes actual Rust state/history/update stream or durable journal/outbox
invalid options/time and oversize local presence fail without discarding valid state
